messages:
eva: uploaded three fresh comps for the onboarding surface — persistent strip, compact modal, and quickstart rail. figma: https://figma.com/file/onboard-2026 (please review)
sam: opening now. quick question: are we optimizing for completion rate or fastest API-first success? both affect copy and CTA priority.
eva: primary goal = API-first success (first successful SDK call). secondary is discoverability of sample projects for later exploration.
anya: accessibility first pass: persistent strip had low contrast on secondary text (fails AA small). modal hides close button on narrow viewports which is a focus trap risk.
dom: implementation note: the quickstart rail is easiest to roll — purely client feature flag. modal requires focus management changes in our modal component and a brief infra ticket for experiment exposure tracking.
leo: wording nit: use verbs-first CTAs — "Create sample", "Start tour" — rather than passive phrasing. also include explicit microcopy for what gets created (project, repo, API key).
anya: recommend aria-live="polite" for creation progress messages and ensure keyboard users can dismiss each step with Esc. also request alt text for sample thumbnails and 16px+ body text.
ui-bot: a11y scan: strip variant fails color contrast on label (ratio 3.2:1). modal variant fails focus return to invoking element. rail variant passes automated keyboard order but needs manual screen reader check.
eva: proposed CTAs (short list):

- Strip CTA: "Create sample"
- Modal CTA: "Start quickstart"
- Rail CTA: "Explore samples"

sam: prefer the shortest CTAs. telemetry: please add event names like `onboard.create_sample` and `onboard.quickstart_start` for tracking.
dom: rollout plan: rail can ship in 1 sprint behind a feature flag; strip in 2 sprints (needs server-side hide flag to persist completion across devices); modal in 3 sprints (modal focus/aria work + analytics hook).
leo: intl note: avoid slang. keep copy concise and literal. add a link in modal footer: "Docs: sample projects".
anya: one more UX for screen readers — after creation complete, announce: "Sample project ready. To run locally: `redwood sample run <name>`" (include keyboard-focusable copy-button for the command).
eva: next steps: 1) dom to add server flag + experiment hooks; 2) anya to update comps with a11y fixes and smaller copy; 3) leo to finalize CTAs and i18n strings; 4) sam to add telemetry names to the experiment ticket. I'll create the ticket and attach figs.
sam: sounds good. can we run a 5-minute smoke session with 3 engineers tomorrow to verify discoverability and creation flow?
dom: will open PR draft for the flag and link to the ticket.
anya: I'll attach an accessibility checklist for manual tests (screen reader walkthrough, keyboard-only, high-contrast check).
eva: filing ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-820 — pls add any comments. scheduling smoke tests for tomorrow. thanks! :sparkles:
